events.text: Sticker system v1 shipped in three commits: foundation (stickerStore + StickerPlacement + skin-box quads + rotatePackedTexture, 9 tests), the Place Sticker tool (K, sticker rail in the action bar, undoable stamps), and the game-docs pair. Formal import flow verified already-honored by texturePackage.ts (bytes copied at import, original path never referenced again). Facade painter is the next arc.
sha correction: the three req_3025 commits are 7b9875f39,c6899bd2f,c8700b6cd (docs, tool, foundation) — the earlier --shas listed 4fa2948f1 in error (that is the prior HEAD).

resolution: Shipped sticker system v1 (three commits: 4bd5a-foundation/c6899-tool/docs — see git log, all citing req_3025). The KEY constraint was already honored: the formal import flow exists in texturePackage.ts — imported images are copied into cart/editor/data/textures/<slug>/ self-contained packages at import, the original path never referenced again; verified end-to-end through ImportImageDialog. Built on top: sticker assets (data/stickers/<slug>/manifest.json = texture ref + meter footprint, 4x6 thermal-label default, materialized on first stamp of any imported texture), StickerPlacement rows on PlacedPiece (piece-local anchor+normal, ride move/delete/undo, persist with the map), rendering as thin skin-box quads through the existing live-skin door with rotation baked into the packed pixel data (zero new Zig, hot-reloads), and the Place Sticker world tool (K) with an action-bar sticker rail (swatches/rotate/scale). 9 unit tests prove the stamp-render round-trip; game docs + index record added. NOT yet built: the multi-piece facade painter at 256 px/m (graffiti strokes) — flagged as the next arc; sticker removal currently rides undo only.
